bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse the provided records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to product metadata using pandas merges and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib and documented missing-data handling.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
